description: Digit sequences shaped like a card number (13-19 digits, separators only between digits so a trailing space/dash after the number isn't swallowed); luhn validation narrows false positives.
US SSN format (###-##-####). Format-only; obviously-invalid area/group numbers are a detector-side refinement, not this pattern's job.

North American phone number formats. Uses digit-adjacency lookarounds instead of \b so a leading '(' or '+' isn't dropped from the match (\b doesn't anchor before punctuation). Requires a separator between digit groups by design, so a bare unformatted 10-digit run (e.g. a tracking or order number) is not flagged. International formats are a follow-up (see docs/phase-1-plan.md open questions).
